It's Vann, Chris's husband. I don't often write to you, but I read something that I wanted to share.
The _New York Times_ published a profile of Chris yesterday with the headline: _" His Election Could Decide Senate Control. He Could Make History, Too."_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1b4028a7-73d1-4bbb-9b68-d6b48fc2a4f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/1b4028a7-73d1-4bbb-9b68-d6b48fc2a4f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Both halves of that headline are true. But Chris is only focused on the first one.**
That's who he is. When the _Times_ asked him about making history, he said he isn't thinking much about it, that he's focused every day on the people of New Hampshire. On the trail it's the same: affordable health care, high prices, corruption in Washington. He means every word. It's one of the many reasons I love him.
But I'm his husband, not his campaign manager, so I get to say the other part out loud: **If Chris wins in less than two weeks, he will be the first out gay man ever to serve in the United States Senate.**
Here's how long this has taken: Barney Frank became the first member of Congress to come out voluntarily in 1987. It took another 25 years for an openly gay candidate, Tammy Baldwin, to win a Senate seat. And in the entire history of that chamber, _**not one out gay man has ever served there.**_
Chris could change that. That matters. It matters to Chris and me, and it matters to people all across this country who have never once seen themselves in that room.
**[In 11 days we can make that history real. If this moment means something to you too, will you chip in to help Chris win?](https://substack.com/redirect/1b4028a7-73d1-4bbb-9b68-d6b48fc2a4f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/1b4028a7-73d1-4bbb-9b68-d6b48fc2a4f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
When Chris was growing up in Manchester, he attended one of the biggest public high schools in the state, and as far as he knew, there wasn't a single out student there. No gay-straight alliance. Nobody to look at and think, _that could be me._ He has said he's now living a life he didn't think was possible back then.
He came out in college, returned home, and ran for the State House at age 22 without hiding who he was. New Hampshire embraced him then, and it's embracing him now. Chris likes to point to our state motto, "Live Free or Die." To him it means people here, whatever their politics, want their neighbors to be free to be themselves. I've watched that play out in coffee shops, at town halls, and on front porches across this state.
And Chris has never been quiet about the fight itself. In 2004 his very first speech on the House floor was against a bill to block New Hampshire from recognizing same-sex marriages. He called it what it was. He lost that vote. Five years later New Hampshire legalized marriage equality, six years before it became the law of the land nationwide. In Congress he became co-chair of the Equality Caucus and has championed bills to expand civil rights protections for LGBTQ Americans and to restore benefits for veterans who were discharged just for being who they are.
**I 've never met anyone more patient about the long game or more stubborn about winning it.**
That's why it meant so much to me that the _Times_ wrote about a young organizer who said that in part because of Chris, he came out to his family and friends and found out the people around him love him for exactly who he is.
There are kids in high schools all over this country right now walking the same hallway Chris did, unsure whether there will be a place for them wherever they want to end up. They're watching this race whether anyone tells them to or not. **If Chris wins they 'll see there's no ceiling on what you can achieve based on who you love.**
Somersworth's Mayor Gerding told the _Times_ this is the kind of milestone you'd want to sing from the rooftops. I agree. **So consider this email my rooftop.**
And it couldn't come at a more important moment. Just last week the Vice President mocked a Democratic Senate candidate by falsely suggesting he was gay, as if that were an insult. As Chris put it, cynical attacks on the LGBTQ community have gone mainstream, and a lot of people are scared about where this country is headed. **A win in New Hampshire would be a loud answer.**
Republicans know what's at stake, too: **This race could decide who controls the Senate.** If we win New Hampshire, Democrats can flip the Senate and finally put a check on this administration. If we lose Republicans keep their grip on the majority, and this era of chaos rolls on. And they're spending over $60 million to do it.
**[This race is about more than Chris. It's about the future of our country. So I'm asking you to make a contribution in the final stretch:](https://substack.com/redirect/1b4028a7-73d1-4bbb-9b68-d6b48fc2a4f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/1b4028a7-73d1-4bbb-9b68-d6b48fc2a4f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**On November 3rd we have a chance to take back the Senate majority** _**and**_**make history on the same night.**
I'm so proud of Chris. I'm so proud of New Hampshire. Thank you for standing with us.
Vann Bentley (Chris's husband)

clean_body: A message from Vann, Chris's husband | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more He doesn't dwell on it, but I want you to understand what this means to people. Oct 23 | | | | | | | | | | | It's Vann, Chris's husband. I don't often write to you, but I read something that I wanted to share. The New York Times published a profile of Chris yesterday with the headline: " His Election Could Decide Senate Control. He Could Make History, Too." | | ---|---|--- Both halves of that headline are true. But Chris is only focused on the first one. That's who he is. When the Times asked him about making history, he said he isn't thinking much about it, that he's focused every day on the people of New Hampshire. On the trail it's the same: affordable health care, high prices, corruption in Washington. He means every word. It's one of the many reasons I love him. But I'm his husband, not his campaign manager, so I get to say the other part out loud: If Chris wins in less than two weeks, he will be the first out gay man ever to serve in the United States Senate. Here's how long this has taken: Barney Frank became the first member of Congress to come out voluntarily in 1987. It took another 25 years for an openly gay candidate, Tammy Baldwin, to win a Senate seat. And in the entire history of that chamber, not one out gay man has ever served there. Chris could change that. That matters. It matters to Chris and me, and it matters to people all across this country who have never once seen themselves in that room. When Chris was growing up in Manchester, he attended one of the biggest public high schools in the state, and as far as he knew, there wasn't a single out student there. No gay-straight alliance. Nobody to look at and think, that could be me. He has said he's now living a life he didn't think was possible back then. He came out in college, returned home, and ran for the State House at age 22 without hiding who he was. New Hampshire embraced him then, and it's embracing him now. Chris likes to point to our state motto, "Live Free or Die." To him it means people here, whatever their politics, want their neighbors to be free to be themselves. I've watched that play out in coffee shops, at town halls, and on front porches across this state. And Chris has never been quiet about the fight itself. In 2004 his very first speech on the House floor was against a bill to block New Hampshire from recognizing same-sex marriages. He called it what it was. He lost that vote. Five years later New Hampshire legalized marriage equality, six years before it became the law of the land nationwide. In Congress he became co-chair of the Equality Caucus and has championed bills to expand civil rights protections for LGBTQ Americans and to restore benefits for veterans who were discharged just for being who they are. I 've never met anyone more patient about the long game or more stubborn about winning it. That's why it meant so much to me that the Times wrote about a young organizer who said that in part because of Chris, he came out to his family and friends and found out the people around him love him for exactly who he is. There are kids in high schools all over this country right now walking the same hallway Chris did, unsure whether there will be a place for them wherever they want to end up. They're watching this race whether anyone tells them to or not. If Chris wins they 'll see there's no ceiling on what you can achieve based on who you love. Somersworth's Mayor Gerding told the Times this is the kind of milestone you'd want to sing from the rooftops. I agree. So consider this email my rooftop. And it couldn't come at a more important moment. Just last week the Vice President mocked a Democratic Senate candidate by falsely suggesting he was gay, as if that were an insult. As Chris put it, cynical attacks on the LGBTQ community have gone mainstream, and a lot of people are scared about where this country is headed. A win in New Hampshire would be a loud answer. Republicans know what's at stake, too: This race could decide who controls the Senate. If we win New Hampshire, Democrats can flip the Senate and finally put a check on this administration. If we lose Republicans keep their grip on the majority, and this era of chaos rolls on. And they're spending over $60 million to do it. On November 3rd we have a chance to take back the Senate majority andmake history on the same night. I'm so proud of Chris. I'm so proud of New Hampshire. Thank you for standing with us. Vann Bentley (Chris's husband) | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Chris Pappas PO Box 313, Manchester, NH 03105 ? ?

Trump's endorsement of Max Engling for Indiana Secretary of State."Congratulations to Max Engling on receiving the endorsement of President Donald J. _**The weak department?**_ I enlisted in the Marine Corps right out of high school. I made sergeant, then spent decades in the Army and retired as a Brigadier General. After 9/11, I led infantry soldiers in combat in Afghanistan. In 2014, I took a team into Liberia while Ebola was killing thousands, because that was the mission and somebody had to go. **I never served with a single weak person in 40 years.** Not the young soldiers who walked patrols knowing what could be waiting for them. Not the medics, mechanics, and cooks who kept us alive and moving. Not the military families who held everything together at home while we were gone. So who does Pete Hegseth think he is? **Our armed forces have never been weak. Not under any president or any party. Those men and women were strong long before he got a podium, and they'll be strong long after he's gone.** Northwest Georgia is full of veterans and military families who know that truth. They deserve a representative who will stand up and say it proudly. Right now, Clay Fuller holds this seat, and I haven't heard him say a word. On November 3, I'm asking voters to send someone to Congress who knows what our troops are made of, because I served with them. **We have 29 days left. Every dollar helps us get this message on TV screens, in mailboxes, and on veterans' doors across the district before Election Day. So I am asking: Can you chip in $25 right now to send a veteran to Congress who will stand up to Pete Hegseth?**

clean_body: | | Pete Hegseth stood in front of our service members and said this: "We are no longer the woke department or the weak department." | The weak department? I enlisted in the Marine Corps right out of high school. I made sergeant, then spent decades in the Army and retired as a Brigadier General. After 9/11, I led infantry soldiers in combat in Afghanistan. In 2014, I took a team into Liberia while Ebola was killing thousands, because that was the mission and somebody had to go. I never served with a single weak person in 40 years. Not the young soldiers who walked patrols knowing what could be waiting for them. Not the medics, mechanics, and cooks who kept us alive and moving. Not the military families who held everything together at home while we were gone. So who does Pete Hegseth think he is? Our armed forces have never been weak. Not under any president or any party. Those men and women were strong long before he got a podium, and they'll be strong long after he's gone. Northwest Georgia is full of veterans and military families who know that truth. They deserve a representative who will stand up and say it proudly. Right now, Clay Fuller holds this seat, and I haven't heard him say a word. On November 3, I'm asking voters to send someone to Congress who knows what our troops are made of, because I served with them. We have 29 days left. Every dollar helps us get this message on TV screens, in mailboxes, and on veterans' doors across the district before Election Day. So I am asking: Can you chip in $25 right now to send a veteran to Congress who will stand up to Pete Hegseth? ~~ ~~ Thank you, Ret. # [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=1154%2E127862%2Ey4etjG)
Folks,
I just made one of the toughest calls of this campaign.
Recently, I signed off on an ad plan for the next couple of days: to amplify our campaign’s message in Las Vegas, Reno, and everywhere in between.
I need to be straight with you: **we don't have all the money to pay for it yet.**
At this point in the race, we have to go big or go home. The polls show MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo and I are locked in a dead heat.
But we’re being heavily outspent over the airwaves, and if this is our last shot to get in front of undecided voters before Lombardo does, I have to go for it.
**[I’m counting on this grassroots team to help fund the final stretch of this race. Can you chip in $5 or any amount today?](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20261023_4_ak.uVzyGJ&amount=5&refcode=em20261023-1154&t=3&akid=1154%2E127862%2Ey4etjG)**

This is our best chance to flip a governor's seat blue in 2026. I believe we can win, but only if we finish strong.
Thank you,
Aaron

subject: I have to ask you this
body:
A goal we cannot afford to miss
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1739&source=&t=1&akid=4830%2E124072%2EQocSSC) | | | |

Hey Peter, it’s Roy. I’m sorry to be direct like this, but I have to ask you to [**_chip in $5 to my campaign right now._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1739&amount=5&t=8&akid=4830%2E124072%2EQocSSC)
President Trump and JD Vance were back in North Carolina earlier this week for a MAGA rally with my opponent Michael Whatley – and President Trump promised to return _again_ next week. So my team and I set a critical daily fundraising goal to make sure we have the resources to fight back and reach every last voter before Election Day. As it stands, we’re falling short. This is a goal we cannot afford to miss.
The GOP has already spent tens of millions to defeat me, and we need the resources to keep pace in this final stretch. If we lose here, Democrats lose our chance at flipping the Senate.
Will you please chip in any amount today to help us win? Not tomorrow, not the next day. _Today, Peter._
Here’s the link one more time: [**_https:/ /secure.actblue.com/donate_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1739&amount=5&t=9&akid=4830%2E124072%2EQocSSC)
Thank you so much,
Roy
| |

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1739&t=2&akid=4830%2E124072%2EQocSSC)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[INSIDE JW]

VICTORY: COURT ORDERS CIA TO BEGIN PRODUCING JANUARY 6 RECORDS

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=39009&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj05WllqX0g4M2hhRSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=aabb201075dbd0b8878c1470071ed74cf0ffc762bdaa9ba1afdd988545708a67

We’ve moved a step closer in our pursuit of the truth about January
6.

A federal court ordered
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=38980&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtY2lhLWo2LXJvbGxpbmctcHJvZHVjdGlvbnMtb3JkZXItMDIxNzIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=4f3b0e70cbbedb418a3f4bb732bc449b02b0d4f383959b7e017d120227ac4b7f
the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) to begin producing records by
November 16, 2026, in response to our Freedom of Information Act
(FOIA) lawsuit seeking information about CIA personnel and support at
the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021.

We filed the July 2024 lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=33154&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvamFudWFyeS02LTIwMjEtcHJvdGVzdHMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=7bb512343050f4a3656cce1ed6020c8a2ed7dea199b5deb42577db46d35d6507 after the CIA
failed to respond to a March 2024 FOIA request asking the agency to
produce records concerning the January 6, 2021, events, including
shots fired and a person shot inside the U.S. Capitol, requests for
CIA assistance, bomb technicians and bomb-detection dogs deployed or
placed on standby, and after-action reports documenting the events
(_Judicial Watch v. Central Intelligence Agency_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=33122&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtY2lhLWo2LXNob3RzLWJvbWItdGVjaC1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDIxNzIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=8b84df049ab10bfd098a3bb94da23b58349406df05f8804a872189b65f146c84
(No. 1:24-cv-02172)).

In March 2024, we received 88 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=31656&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY2lhLWJvbWItdGVjaHMtamFudWFyeS02Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=9e0816de04e53527e2468ddc406a1d27f37eedb88eb3218f02166fdee9037619 of Bureau of
Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) records from the
Department of Justice in a FOIA lawsuit that show the CIA deployed
personnel to Washington, DC on January 6, 2021.

The records include a series of text messages under the heading
“January 7 Intel Chain
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=31595&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWF0Zi1qYW4tNi1wcm9kLTEtMDE2MDgtcGdzLTQ5LTg4L13igJ0/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=5faf2a212bc0ca95dd7ac16ec3d4df308f4343310937997df8c33a5040cf95d0
in which two separate references to participation by the CIA are made.
One states
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=31596&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWF0Zi1qYW4tNi1wcm9kLTEtMDE2MDgtcGctNjUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=0e772c1b3ab93f5c23a726206e94e8cc610a9c69c67b05cea417433c17fd1fc5
that “two CIA bomb techs” are assisting with “a pipe bomb scene
on New Jersey and D ST SE.” Another record references “several CIA
dog teams on standby
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=31597&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWF0Zi1qYW4tNi1wcm9kLTEtMDE2MDgtcGctNzIvXS7igJ0/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=43532271ab074e118c4fea4443f425a7d12be93530011fde38e2bb49c6d38820

In the October 15, 2026, minute order
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=38980&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtY2lhLWo2LXJvbGxpbmctcHJvZHVjdGlvbnMtb3JkZXItMDIxNzIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==],&H=8ddd506da42b3b646c634eec29f56f5b283279ccaf5b93406c615e49e581c9a4 U.S.
District Judge Jia M. Cobb directed the CIA to begin rolling interim
productions of responsive records by November 16, rejecting the
agency’s refusal to provide records next year:

> MINUTE ORDER re [24] Notice: Defendant received Plaintiff’s
> request in March 2024, ECF 1 ¶ 8, and, at one point, represented
> that it “anticipated beginning rolling productions no later than
> April 2025,” ECF 23 at 2. Defendant did not meet that anticipated
> deadline after identifying additional necessary searches. ECF 23 at
> 2. The Court’s September 24, 2026 minute order directed Defendant
> to identify a date certain on which it would begin rolling interim
> productions of responsive records. Defendant’s [24] notice
> indicated that it will not process rolling productions and will
> instead produce non-exempt responsive material by May 24, 2027.
> Because Defendant did not provide a date certain to begin rolling
> productions as the Court ordered, and has offered no explanation for
> its position, the Court will set a date that it finds reasonable
> based on the record. Accordingly, the Court ORDERS Defendant to
> begin rolling interim productions of responsive records by November
> 16, 2026. Signed by Judge Jia M. Cobb on October 15, 2026. (lcjmc1)

We are obviously pleased that the court clapped back against the
CIA’s utter contempt for the American people’s right to know what
it was up to at the U.S. Capitol on January 6. We look forward to
finally getting documents next month – after years of cover-up.

We have pursued details of January 6 on several fronts.

In July 2026, we forced the release
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=38173&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvamFudWFyeS02LWJvZHljYW0tdmlkZW9zLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=2fe0bf168e13a15f29df95dc506e5026189bbee7259a072a391f1e6a38f37cb5 of over
1,000 hours of Washington, DC, Metropolitan Police Department
body-worn camera footage from the January 6, 2021, U.S. Capitol event.

In April 2026, we filed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=35132&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaXJzLXRhcmdldGluZy1vZi1qYW51YXJ5LTYtcHJvdGVzdGVycy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]&H=a8a3385c99636ccd810da588a7397cd9e65611f44ae7cc11b00b8e70ab4e3831
a FOIA lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=35132&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaXJzLXRhcmdldGluZy1vZi1qYW51YXJ5LTYtcHJvdGVzdGVycy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]&H=a8a3385c99636ccd810da588a7397cd9e65611f44ae7cc11b00b8e70ab4e3831
against the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) to obtain records related
to possible improper targeting of January 6, 2021, Capitol protesters,
their supporters, and related nonprofits.

In July 2025, we sued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=36077&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbGFzdC1taW51dGUtajYtdGFyZ2V0aW5nLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=c260cfdcebfb3d81e69172efc57959b829835b2beb64c48f9da7354f2cebadd6 the U.S.
Department of Justice for records on accelerated January 6
prosecutions after Donald Trump was elected president in November
2024.

In June 2025, we obtained
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=35379&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvNC05NzUtbWlsbGlvbi1zZXR0bGVtZW50LW9mLWFzaGxpLWJhYmJpdHQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=96188e4e65688362fdd98da812c6142d95c61fe1d96041b6fd2f7b5ae927aa70
a $4.975 million settlement
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=35357&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2VzdGF0ZS1vZi1hc2hsaS1iYWJiaXR0LWV0LWFsLXYtdS1zLWEtc2V0dGxlbWVudC0wMDAzMy0wMTcwMS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE]&H=ff5994d0c48db4192a45b257a3a75ad0d9da9aeb0ba7b56e02ab98f3322c6e79
in the wrongful death lawsuit against the U.S. Government filed on
behalf of the family of Ashli Babbitt, the U.S. Air Force veteran who
was shot and killed [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=35358&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS91aU1zUnZObjkxZz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=0d87b5111743b2bcf353e9a68e63f25bca51ca6b99082f704720188db4211eb9 inside the U.S.
Capitol by then-Capitol Police Lt. Michael Byrd on January 6, 2021.
Ashli Babbitt was the only January 6 homicide victim.

In October 2023, we received the declaration
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=30448&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvamFudWFyeS02Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=73cbc8360f846f170bd4409af4e9478c366cd0fac32ccaaf26fdd46cc2032cad of James W. Joyce, senior
counsel in the Office of the General Counsel for the Capitol Police,
in which he describes emails among senior officials of the United
States Capitol Police (USCP) in January 2021 that show warnings of
possible January 6 protests that could lead to serious disruptions at
the U.S. Capitol.

JUDICIAL WATCH SUES FOR FBI’S ‘ROSETTA STONE’ REPORT ON
TRUMP-RUSSIA PROBE

We are suing the U.S. Department of Justice for a 2021 FBI report on
Operation Crossfire Hurricane, the controversial investigation into
alleged 2016 Trump campaign ties to Russia.

We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=38990&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb3NzZmlyZS1odXJyaWNhbmUtY29tcGxhaW50LTAzNjAzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=9816e9a6940030dc5efac04a1f162abe44db53dc070d35bd6769d2b13654ae56
against the Justice Department for a 2021 investigative report by the
FBI’s Office of Professional Responsibility (OPR) concerning
Operation Crossfire Hurricane, the FBI’s investigation into alleged
links between the 2016 Trump presidential campaign and Russia
(_Judicial Watch, Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=38990&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb3NzZmlyZS1odXJyaWNhbmUtY29tcGxhaW50LTAzNjAzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=9816e9a6940030dc5efac04a1f162abe44db53dc070d35bd6769d2b13654ae56
(1:26-cv-03603)).

We sued after the FBI failed to respond to an August 7, 2026, FOIA
request for the following records:

> A copy of the investigative report produced by the FBI’s Office of
> Professional Responsibility in 2021 relating to Operation Crossfire
> Hurricane, reportedly consisting of approximately 400 pages, plus
> approximately 7,000 pages of attachments, as more fully described at
> https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=38992&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9yLnpyeS5uZXQvMjAyNi8wOC9pcy1mYmktaGlkaW5nLXRoZS00MDAtcGFnZS1yb3NldHRhLXN0b25lLXRoYXQtY291bGQtc2VhbC1qb2huLWJyZW5uYW5zLWZhdGUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&H=9c18fa06342911e737500ffa39cd40791b308b4a6d0dfce3326ffbf180dbd228
> [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=38992&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9yLnpyeS5uZXQvMjAyNi8wOC9pcy1mYmktaGlkaW5nLXRoZS00MDAtcGFnZS1yb3NldHRhLXN0b25lLXRoYXQtY291bGQtc2VhbC1qb2huLWJyZW5uYW5zLWZhdGUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==]&H=87e97414edaf91d7d499d602dcd21d434651b18c982e417df8472f129909728d

In August 2026 investigative journalist Paul Sperry reported
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86176&L=38993&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9wYXVsc3BlcnJ5Xy9zdGF0dXMvMjA4NTIwNzQ2ODgyNTUzNDgyNj91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=]&H=e74640dc3bf76624927be4671201724fa7261ba86e7cdb8725e6456367ae5d00 that sources
told him the FBI was withholding from declassification a 2021 Office
of Professional Responsibility report examining Crossfire Hurricane.
According to Sperry, the report contains approximately 400 pages and

Central Intelligence Agency [ (No. 1:24-cv-02172)). In March 2024, we received 88 pages [ of Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) records from the Department of Justice in a FOIA lawsuit that show the CIA deployed personnel to Washington, DC on January 6, 2021. The records include a series of text messages under the heading “January 7 Intel Chain [ in which two separate references to participation by the CIA are made. Cobb directed the CIA to begin rolling interim productions of responsive records by November 16, rejecting the agency’s refusal to provide records next year: MINUTE ORDER re [24] Notice: Defendant received Plaintiff’s request in March 2024, ECF 1 ¶ 8, and, at one point, represented that it “anticipated beginning rolling productions no later than April 2025,” ECF 23 at 2. In September 2019 we released State Department records [ revealing that Steele had an extensive and close working relationship dating back to May of 2014 with high-ranking Obama State Department officials including Jonathan Winer and Victoria Nuland. In August 2019 we obtained “302” report material [ from 2016 FBI interviews of Associate Deputy U.S. Attorney Bruce Ohr, who was removed from his position in December 2017. (A Form 302 is used by FBI agents to memorialize interviews they undertake during an investigation.) In a November 22, 2016, interview, Ohr said that “reporting on Trump’s ties to Russia were going to the Clinton Campaign, Jon Winer at the U.S. State Department and the FBI.” In a late September 2016 interview, Ohr described a person (likely Christopher Steele) as “desperate that Donald Trump not get elected and was passionate about him not being the U.S. President.” A report states that “Ohr knew that [Fusion GPS’s] Glen Simpson and others were talking to Victoria Nuland at the U.S. State Department.” In July 2019 we obtained records [ revealing a September 2016 email exchange between then-Assistant Secretary of State Victoria Nuland and Special Coordinator for Libya Jonathan Winer, a close associate of dossier author Christopher Steele, discussing a “face-to-face” meeting on a “Russian matter.” In August 2018 the Justice Department admitted in a Judicial Watch FOIA lawsuit court filing that the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court held no hearings [ on the FISA spy warrant applications targeting Carter Page, a former Trump campaign part-time advisor who was the subject of four controversial FISA warrants. U.S. TAKES ‘FEW ENFORCEMENT ACTIONS’ ON HIGH RISK VISA OVERSTAYS We know our southern border was wide open under the Biden administration, but it turns out that our visa program is also seriously flawed. Our Corruption Chronicles blog has the details [ As if it weren’t bad enough that the U.S. government has long compromised national security by losing track of foreigners—like several of the 9/11 terrorists—who overstay their visa, in many cases it fails to take enforcement actions on solid leads of those who may pose a threat to the country. This is a huge problem because every year tens of millions of foreign nationals receive nonimmigrant visas to enter the U.S. for tourism, business or study and hundreds of thousands stay beyond their authorized period of admission annually, violating the terms of the visa which the feds categorize as overstays. The State Department issues the visas, and a new federal probe [ reveals that from fiscal year 2021 to 2024, the agency distributed more than 31 million. Incredibly, under the Biden administration’s lax rules over 12 million were granted without required vetting of in-person interviews or fingerprint collection, putting the country at risk by approving certain visa holders who represent national security or safety threats. Adding insult to injury, federal authorities took few enforcement actions even when they had “targeted leads” concerning foreigners who overstayed their visa, according to the recently published investigation conducted by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Inspector General. “As a result, foreign nationals who potentially posed threats to the United States remained at large despite their illegal status,” the watchdog confirms. The lapse is like a punch in the gut for the American public two and a half decades after Islamic terrorists exploited this inefficient system for tracking foreigners who overstay visas to remain in the country. It allowed the 9/11 hijackers to live in the U.S., plan, and conduct the deadliest terrorist attack on American soil, killing nearly 3,000 people. After the attacks Congress created a system to track the entry and exit of foreign nationals by using electronically scanned fingerprints and photographs. It was called the U.S. Visitor and Immigration Status Indicator Technology (US VISIT), and it was seriously flawed even though the government invested around a billion dollars over several years to get it going. It never worked properly, however. Now we find out that even when visa overstays are credibly identified as a possible threat to the nation, federal authorities do not act. As unbelievable as this may seem, the recently published audit reveals that in the four fiscal years examined Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) received over 3 million overstay leads of which it categorized 104,049 as potential national security and public safety concerns. Even the highest priority visa overstay led investigations representing only the maximum risk led to few arrests, DHS investigators found. During the four years analyzed Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) identified 1,769 so-called “Priority 1” leads and conducted 84 probes that resulted in just two arrests. The number of foreigners who overstay their visa and remain unmonitored inside the country has grown significantly in the quarter century since Al Qaeda operatives executed the deadliest terrorist attack in American history. Years ago, the investigative arm of Congress, the Government Accountability Office (GAO) found [ that nearly half of the nation’s illegal aliens entered the U.S. legally and overstayed their visa undetected. Other federal investigations have revealed that the U.S. has failed to remove millions with expired visas, including DHS losing track of hundreds of dangerous foreigners that “could pose a national security or public safety concerns.” Every year the government fails to catch hundreds of thousands of foreign nationals who overstay their visa. In fiscal year 2015 it was more than half a million [ including thousands from terrorist nations like Pakistan, Iraq, Yemen, Libya, and Syria. A few years later the number of overstays increased to 702,000 [ Among them was a Portuguese man charged in the gruesome kidnap and murder of a young woman whose body was found bound in a suitcase on a Connecticut street. Both Nieshalla and Elliott serve on the State Board of Finance, which has worked to reimburse local governments for revenue lost during the gas tax suspension.**WATCH THE NEW AD BELOW:** [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhtehy-hhlljjcji-r/) [Watch the new ad highlighting fiscal responsibility, tax relief, and efforts to keep Indiana affordable.](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhtehy-hhlljjcji-y/) "Hoosiers deserve transparency, accountability, and responsible stewardship of every taxpayer dollar," said State Comptroller Elise Nieshalla. "From strengthening financial transparency to ensuring our local communities receive the funding they depend on, my focus remains on giving Hoosiers a clear picture of how their tax dollars are managed and holding government accountable to the people it serves.""Fiscal responsibility means making smart decisions today that protect taxpayer dollars and preserve Indiana's long-term financial stability," said State Treasurer Daniel Elliott. "As Treasurer, my responsibility is to safeguard public funds, manage state investments wisely, and ensure taxpayer dollars are working for Hoosiers. My focus remains on transparency, accountability, and responsible financial management."Nieshalla oversees Indiana's accounting and financial reporting, including the Indiana Transparency Portal, while Elliott serves as the state's chief investment officer, managing state investments and safeguarding public funds."Elise and Daniel have established records of fiscal leadership in their respective offices," said Indiana Republican Party Chairwoman Lana Keesling. "From excellence in state financial reporting to strong investment returns, their work has produced measurable results for Indiana. Those accomplishments give Hoosiers a record they can count on as they head to the polls on November 3."**Election Day is Tuesday, November 3, 2026.** Indiana's future belongs to the Hoosiers who show up. Make your plan, bring a friend, and make your voice heard at the ballot box.### [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhtehy-hhlljjcji-j/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhtehy-hhlljjcji-t/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhtehy-hhlljjcji-i/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhtehy-hhlljjcji-d/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhtehy-hhlljjcji-h/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhtehy-hhlljjcji-k/) ** PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE. ****NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE. ****WWW.INDIANA.GOP.** | Indiana Republican State Committee 101 W. name: Rick Bennett
subject: $400 million in political ads. Imagine the alternative.
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Bennett for Governor · P
body:
Reject outside dark money and put those resources toward helping Maine families instead.

| | |
---
---
---
---
Peter,

On Thursday I held my final town hall where I rejected outside dark money and called for putting those resources toward helping Maine families instead.

**In today’s corrupt system, too many wealthy special interests use staggering amounts of money to influence our elections.** These dark money forces pull the strings behind the scenes as the full scope of their influence remains hidden from public view.

Here in Maine, we can expect to see over $400 million spent – in the U.S. Senate race alone. That is enough to provide free meals to school age kids for the next 10 years.

More money is going to negative attack ads in the Maine Senate race than is allocated to winter heating oil assistance for the entire state.

These groups that are dumping millions and millions into Maine’s elections do not care that Maine families are struggling with higher housing costs, higher energy bills, and higher health care costs. They see Maine people’s pain as nothing more than political opportunity.

So Thursday in Freeport, alongside many of you, **I called on not just Hannah Pingree and Bobby Charles – but also Troy Jackson and Susan Collins – to reject the hundreds of millions of dollars in out-of-state dark money flooding this election, and to ask those organizations spending that money to direct it towards helping our friends and neighbors in need.**

Mainers do not need another toxic TV ad or mendacious mailer telling them how bad the other guy is. We don’t accept a scorched earth politics engendering fear and hatred. Mainers need affordable heating oil, housing that is within reach, and healthcare that is accessible.

**I ask you to put your money towards organizations and community groups that will truly help our neighbors in the coming months.**

But, we still need your help in these final few days:
1. [Watch this clip and share it with three people you know who are tired of the same two parties running the same playbook.](https://www.supportrickbennett.com/r?u=0ZEw3rKCYdU6QDR4jANpCzJgPR1oXz7mjSdU-TTQM5mRE2riSovjnJJrr-Ndr714VARBWAQV-bkxq8JBwrpMycUtg6GH60CRjan247V_fUZXM9e6p2nwLF_O7kD4ya-eLWYZvXDM9C9mgbFyoXE3RSnX1H8oFIJIEHMIjRhr3phUto2EMlNQY2HgmYDzWZrj_puGP8LWgQKCsyuiSIoVGx3n8JA0HBNwPOTWlnLS6LRW9GtC8XgmaBMtr_525Ej9&e=939e09e235be96b0bea768d960703804&utm_source=bennettforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_23_money_in_politics&n=1)
2. Talk to your neighbors about this campaign. A personal conversation moves more votes than any ad.
3. Make your plan to vote, and help someone else make theirs.

Thank you,

Rick

## Melania Brokers Truce in Ukraine City
Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a [localized ceasefire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1yqzAQRp8GOjHS8iNRqLgNnW-bklnBYm8swLMIE799hsRvkPbszM53zselvyBHXq7_cSafprVf6NgipUTSzxRxYQyy3km2JPtA9DUFxh40NMpoBVWPQ-In9SYf_UQEVObkjW3BldY6k998HRoH0DRgWhe0MzpQsGOoy7GuXKNtzv58ZzRURkNbtgUEbY1zE07aYWkpqzSNnFYpPlde0o2m-FqfJMWwznn0t5QeW1b-y6DLoDuOo1jCcGqc95OsEscMuv0uyAtl0Mm-bYzqDRRehUgNhBtNLKQGTi_1a02jeldQSfb5oWRYsNE1GJuLHx8Hx8hbY7NKX2fk-DMp_S3k08N3AAAA__952olS) in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, Ukraine, brokered by first lady Melania Trump, the White House said Friday. The truce is set to [begin Oct. 29](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ_GdEb22gdc4SIN3Z82JVpgfWzOYGSbI7x9RJQ3-LuRRhrN9_36Gr6QA2-vn7iSKz4OG505UCmUhpUCboxjim9KuaRjIvrjR8YBFDRSKwl2wKnwhwZdzc4TAZmKnG6f0Jm27XS1OECcHg3aRwPKGrIPmkijNaozZrSdrtjdc1qB1Qqe5lnDqFrddR696tC0JKyimUtM9e_IW1nIhyt-KNVTXKvgllL2LMwPAb2A_jzPehrzjXH3Avo7Cug9p1xkwPmS_8FkSce6y0LrHhOmS06EmTwnkunImVEe74S8kYyB8vK-BPRVcvN-cgicm1ZY9VqRw78j5Xv6Pg7-BgAA___2wIcV) and is meant to let humanitarian aid in and move civilians out through a designated safe passageway. Melania Trump said the remaining residents are mostly elderly and need medicine, food, and clean water. The White House said the first lady and a representative worked directly with both governments on the terms. Oleshky, once a city of about 24,000 on the Dnipro River, [fell on the first day](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu3CAQQE-DO1Yw8I23oEjjbtOmtDAelsliYwFeZ28fOcoNfvekkebNm1-P6eEo0fb86Va0LeRpw7MmbA3LtGJyG7m55BeW2srhEf-EmdwEAnouBQc9Od_ojZPsFhsQAVWHVpo7DMqYQXbR6kX2Snt_X9RX_-WVEXroe0BtZqmEwY7stU4K0FLAXd1vMAsjhyG4IAanDDItcKGWy-13pq1FDOmT31huPq9dsrG1vTL1g8HIYDzP8_aqrl1DBuOVw2Dcc6JG_sJLxmCU4mLFYPyfyVs51p1HTHvlIZcnco-uYqCCfEGXOG28HLWS23j2_tgJF54T1vj68BaRn5Ea8piPiry6zyXril32k1Ki2humxXN1lP7d3b737beFvwEAAP__mXqU0A) of the 2022 invasion. Moscow has not commented publicly. Ukraine's top negotiator said the humanitarian operation would begin once the truce takes hold.
## Ex-FBI Agents Charged in Hunter Biden Case
Two former senior FBI officials surrendered on arrest warrants Friday after being [charged with lying to Congress](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu3CAURL8Gd1hwcYy3oEjjbtOmtABf7JtgsIBdZ_8-8vuF14000mjO-f1cnpYipe2XPdC0kJeEV43YGpblwGgTWVfyXyy1lZdH_Bcc2QUEjFwKDsNifaM3LrJbTUAEVB0aqR8wKa0n2e3GyRGFHQH9Dz0obcFrqVwQ0zop1KA7MvecFDBIAQ_16MEJLacp2CAmqzSyQeBKLZf-T6bUdgzxk99Yep-PLpq9tbMy9ZPBzGC-rqv3rt4Yd89gviODOTjiOQTyZGPlfrdlw5XHD6WNt8x9TlvBWvn-Sg0Ld7Ri4tGeLZ8M5q6Y9bwoRqqjZoPYDkvx60D7nra3gf8BAAD__6r-g6g) about the bureau's Hunter Biden investigations. Nikki Cole Floris, 46, and Bradley Benavides, 56, who ran the now-dissolved Foreign Influence Task Force, each face [one count of making false statements](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0E2SnSAUQOHV6AwLgVYcMMjEWWeaocXPRW8H4RVcNW_3qWQLvYFTp75fn9unxYR5_2lPMBTLluFpCYigbickm9G6Wn5DbVQvD_AnOrSb4GJiI2dCbdYT3rCNfTARQIDswYzzIrScZz32h1F6cV5O4HlYrJRR6VF-TMBnFz6UCrpH8y83cqFGLha5DMLxedQ62si1lTN0ikNAKnX4KpjpgJje5YY6-HL2yRxEr9bJH51YO7E-zzN8XY3Qw7CXuxPr1WxhwXdifdVOrPQUFks9obLokJUY0aNNjfnD1h0CS2_MO_Ml7xVaY9aVi9hxZYLKHAbIDPMNjXC3hCW3vprwejAlbNPcKb6fFtP_N_qe6G3E3wAAAP__eDOOcw). Both told the House Judiciary Committee in 2023 that the task force played no role in the Hunter Biden cases. Benavides testified that he first learned the FBI had the laptop by [reading a Wikipedia article](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u4yAQBeCnwR0RjJ3YLii2cZdtt7T4GezZxWABTjZvf8V9hduNNJpPc86f5_rUFChuv_WBqvq0RnyXgLViXg8MOpI2Of3DXGq-LOJ_b0ivIODBpeAwrNpWeuEqO6c8ImDfoZLjDFM_jpPsduUGPRl3x97cZz0KLb1_WASYhblbM2BHqnFSwCAFzP18AyNGOU1eezHpfkQ2CHRUU779TRTrjj580gvzzaajC2qv9Sys_8VgYbDEz5lKbSsGS4MZLFK0uWewXIW3gAwWb4gn78mSDoW_98RtM9Hx6-T7FStmbshh5EGfNZ3c7jpv6LhPmYcPxY3XdhO3jKWBXVbufFMIVB4jG8R2aArfL9afFftS8BUAAP__GRGOSw) in 2023. Prosecutors say he discussed the laptop routinely with FBI colleagues before the 2020 election. Attorneys for Floris called the case "nonsense" and noted it was filed [10 days before](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO2zAQRU9DdTTIoS3KBYs06jYIkCKlMCKH0mQpcUHO2tnbB84VUn_g47336215Qy58bt_xoCC5Lic9eyERastBBU_GtdV3al3aZyT6k1fGBQyM2hoN1wWj8IMWO6SQiYDcQMH6O0zO-8kOewBKK8EtTYjZ3Ufjc3IZrR3HiLfk7cDhdWcNXK2Bu7tfYDXeTlPGbCZ0ntTVUGKp7fK78ik75fJVH9QusR5DCbvIR1fum4JZwYxrfCm8NgXzj1pYOHYF85Mb_ZTavhTMoPPKuubMkbF0HXdsGyV94Dufm85YOukuKHTQKV3vn6dQ09b5mzU354cW0seTS-E-enU124Fc_uHI_0V8BPgbAAD__y0mh_Q) the Nov. 3 midterm elections. The judge refused a prosecution request to delay the preliminary hearing for more than two weeks and set the hearing for Tuesday.
## Ranking: Ballparks from Oldest to Newest
The World Series opened last night in Milwaukee with the Brewers beating the Tampa Bay Rays 3-2 in a 25-year-old ballpark that sits right in the middle of a new [ranking of all 30](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OozAQAJ8GOiN7TfgpXFxDl2uvRGtYJ74sGNkbuHv7T_le4etHM9L8uc93jBz3x2_cyElI805XYRKhPG_EuEf0Ob0oF8nvhehf8BFn0NApoxW0My4ST5pNvbpABGRrcqYfYbB9P5j66W52QLt0o0eDAdphNWPb4tgZb_F281BH99EZDa3RMNqxAa97MwwBgx7Q9lS1mtYoKTd_U9zlSYH_p5Nys6StZvcUOUplf1UwVTBd19WcsbyRFzyiIMciH7CCKeP-olVt7JVH5gPzq6iQ06YSr1RESVI7XVSkgqnObj2uyBxL11etfmwY-bsoP_t0OvgKAAD__14GfqA) major league parks by age. Fenway Park, which opened in 1912, and Wrigley Field, from 1914, are the only two ballparks left that predate 1960. MLB dates every park to its [first regular-season game](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAUheGnwRsWXGywB4Yu3tK1o4XDJaEBE8Ft3L595b5C5yN90vk_LuvFxRT327vLaCmUdcejJSTCumZMbo9uq-WBtVH9uiJ-hy26FQRoLgWHYXVXii9cZedtQARUHVppZpiUMZPs7hbVGLQfYdOgvVbjbAYDM-jJ-WHUDrpoT04KGKSAWc09bMLIaQouiMkpg2wQ6COV2n-WuNMdQ_opL6z9teQu2TvRszH1xmBhsBzH0ee0nRuD5XzDYMlp409XH42HWjIvyWMjToXveGCjrlr_PGJKsWnDBnHLLqY_nf7X5GXhNwAA___UgXYi). Only five parks are at least 40 years old, and 19 of the 30 opened between 1990 and 2009. Milwaukee's American Family Field held its first game in 2001 and Tropicana Field, in its rebuilt form, opened this April after [$58 million in repairs](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1y6yAQx0-DOjyw6FlSQfEadU6bUrOIxdoECQ0QO759hlwh3c78Zv9f77flhhz5uL_hTraGtBz0LJFqpbzsFPFgdDl9Ui41f61E38ExLqDgKrWS0C-4Vn7QojtvAxGQ6cjqYYLRDMOou80S_PNhAuMV9tSb4K6a9Nr74J0zzk0d2yanFfRawWSmCzg16HEMGNSIZiDRK_JcU758JD7qRiG-0oPyZU17F-1W61mE-S9gFjA7fLUKU4MC5hAFzBX3EwXMDQiYm52AWat2Q-M5nbzigTIwRS-fHKPcUqmybiSfKUcvC2WmIjFUylLuHCOnQ_IhM53IuXTZ-rM9crkOolf3HTn-Jqx_2_Vh4ScAAP__cbCNmw) to its hurricane-shredded roof. Game 2 is tonight in Milwaukee, and the series moves to the Trop on Monday. The dome is on borrowed time either way, with the Rays due to open a [new Tampa ballpark](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GuonsgWAoKLahe9tuiQYzTubF2MhMwubvV9lfeN2VrnR0dP58zV8kUdLtN208ashz4vOIrMpl3jhSElpKfnA5tDw989-wCM1osANrANuZvMqLZ1uvY2BGbmoerRuwb5zrbX0fu2Vt0FybtjVuCZ1rmcgO1CH5NXg31DJ-cNZgaw0OzXDBxTjb94GC6alxXLWGV9FcLt9Zkt45xHd-cbn4vNVxvKvuR9X8qnCqcDrP8_I44uercKKi4iNXOF1tZ93VYYWT0rYTLPSGQu8DDlYIuUDiE7BZ4FBa5bnBXvI3ewUKygV8fiZ9A6UVvHzGvpf8YgiSKHlJN9gjpbqM635KjHJ0rmrNbSP571Lrz-q-RvwXAAD__-1nkLM) in 2029.
| _Flying together with our sponsor_ [](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0bGOGyEQBuCnYbu1YMALW1BEOrm7tCkRC8N5cixY7JwvefvIVpIyTdrRfDO_9H97Da-RKrW3r3FHz6WHhp9HRWYcYccaG8Vt9HccB4-PhPijbBQDSFhmJWcwISamOwY1ZV8QAfWEXtkVnLbWqenqsysxnQFW1BJXKcEArk7jOTkJOpWJ_OOckmCUhFWvJ9ikVc6VWKSL2qIwEjNxH6fvnRpfsdSf_Y7jlPo-VX9lvh1CfxFwEXDhEdP7n8VY-Zp6K5SxMcX6EAIuqzKLOdsyu3LeZmOSmbdscV7KWiRma2FzQl9uNSbcsbHQL79fhuPW29FH2CO18MgMi4AlZspCv6j2wYMeABZ-TjINTLyFf_DwV03D59sn1UrHYoWRb3ukZ-SJ_6-au4dfAQAA__8hr6QC) **After 60, Knee Health Comes Down to 1 Nutrient Most Doctors Miss** After 60, standing up can mean gripping the armrest, rocking forward, and bracing for that first stiff step. Most people blame age or wear and tear. [But nearly 40 years of research](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0bGOGyEQBuCnYbu1YMALW1BEOrm7tCkRC8N5cixY7JwvefvIVpIyTdrRfDO_9H97Da-RKrW3r3FHz6WHhp9HRWYcYccaG8Vt9HccB4-PhPijbBQDSFhmJWcwISamOwY1ZV8QAfWEXtkVnLbWqenqsysxnQFW1BJXKcEArk7jOTkJOpWJ_OOckmCUhFWvJ9ikVc6VWKSL2qIwEjNxH6fvnRpfsdSf_Y7jlPo-VX9lvh1CfxFwEXDhEdP7n8VY-Zp6K5SxMcX6EAIuqzKLOdsyu3LeZmOSmbdscV7KWiRma2FzQl9uNSbcsbHQL79fhuPW29FH2CO18MgMi4AlZspCv6j2wYMeABZ-TjINTLyFf_DwV03D59sn1UrHYoWRb3ukZ-SJ_6-au4dfAQAA__8hr6QC) out of Spain found the real culprit -- and it isn't just cartilage loss or inflammation. Friend,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let us explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.

## I-30 Shuts Down in Downtown Dallas
All lanes of I-30 through downtown Dallas [close at 10 p.m.](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3CAQQL8Gd7OCMWvsgiKNu0ub0hrDeE0Ow8qQ5fbvI0f3B6mf9KT3fn0sHxRiSI-fdLCtX1teErcSuVY-l9DLsv-pPrd0UEohPTY6QnyvC0ocQElAvZCr4cWLps7bVfpJdWyVmXDsJ6NNt9sBx35Y7wbd3Q-rZ0mD8ZthHtV4V6Ppgr10SqJWSiL2N2mUdGYk7Yxf2UuhJftQ83mrO1f-orLFd37xeXP56KLda30W0f8QOAucW2u3tDq_tQsLnK8igXPMjqLA2VOMVODI51UE39RReucEzzP_ZlehhRjBxVwYKEYI0EuIlLhASHANqbkl-FbVPRRozJ-cPOx8coG2U4Wa4TPlJnDWctIGe4Fzd1r_vOyhDEZo-TgoxH8d9X__vyz-DQAA__8Gq5yA) tonight and stay shut until 5 a.m. on Monday. The closure covers both directions between I-35E and the I-45/U.S. 75 interchange, with traffic detoured onto Woodall Rodgers Freeway (Spur 366). TxDOT is urging drivers to avoid the area if they can. The shutdown is part of the $888 million I-30 Canyon Project, which broke ground in March and runs through 2031. The Texas A&M Transportation Institute ranks the Canyon as the state's 11th most congested corridor. Some crossings will stay closed long after this weekend: [Botham Jean/Lamar Boulevard](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFurDAQRb_GdEb2YGEoXLyGbl-bEg32sFgxZgUTzP59RKR8Qboz0uhenfvxGB8YU8zP_7iS42vexkzlSMRM-xgbdSxfHLaSV8w55ueMa0zvaQQFrdRKghnRczxpNFgFN6nQ64qctj10TW-NrRYXJttpbLzCvgOktp1bMgZa8tM8gQ5VdHecVmC0VgBNraxW3nZovA0TBSWMohB522teiOnCY07v7aS99ttaJbcwvw7R_BMwCBhKKfW8XeYWuR8EDDcKGH5lZJSNkjfxfQVMCQ9J14s8U5CF6JNyqHYXXiWmFI_WCqOeK8b008h_Xep08B0AAP__aAl_-w) through late 2027 and Cesar Chavez Boulevard through late 2028. Austin drivers also will be hit with detours this weekend as [downtown streets close](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGS4yAQRL8GZbhghCU5ILhE2V56oWosBmtqEWyJsfD-_ZX3PuHi7nrVr_98LB_IifPjN-7k5RXLkqnVRCJ0LNybuj0llJZ3zJnzI-LO6fu-gIFBW6PBLbgKn7Q47IK_m3CzHXk73mDqb6Mbu83HdYgu2okGF-g6gJkQpmBdD-56NaHv2L9x1oCz1gD0FzNas44TunUMdwpGOUOBpRwX2UjohTWm73LScVnL3iW_iXxV1f9SMCuYW2uXzxfmd6hgfvsomFNZMSmY8VmFs4K5ykEkek2lPg-qmrN-i0ppWf8radm46kb0STnoWA4drT75RJ1QnxxQR6rC5w-3O3z4apwS12FUzjx25PSzT_7319PD3wAAAP__3zqPiw) for today's Viva La Vida Day of the Dead festival and the Formula 1 U.S. Grand Prix, which wraps up Sunday at Circuit of the Americas.
## Texas SNAP Enrollment Hits 17-Year Low
Texas SNAP enrollment hit a [17-year low](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unTAMx58mbDlKTIDLkKEL2-3aERliwGpIEHEPl7evuFKfoJuln_z_-vU5fiJHTutP3MnL15LHRFeJJELnyLUp2x8J-Uo7psRpXXDneE8jGGi1NRrciLPwm0aHVfCTCb2tyNuuh4-671xXbb6F2jQNUht6a6CZWqqN62FuXNOa0C4V-0fOGnDWGoD6ZTpr5u4D3dyFiYJRzlBgyedLNhL6wrLEO7_pfM15r6LfRI6i6h8KBgXDdV2v3wXlgQqGp4-C4ftNwfBYKRisee76H9Al4aEPPIVnPlA4Jx3OfBQtWaO2nb4JTx3zpbFo2UgvFIoWXjehpCnyyhNHllvBUJ0-HBfHyKXtlDPrjhy_o8r_Tvz28DcAAP__YuKQGA) of 2.8 million in September after falling 20.8% in a year, the steepest drop in two decades, with children making up more than half the losses. The drop follows last year's federal budget law, which extended work requirements to more parents and adults up to 64. It also [ties state costs](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtSAQhZ9GuzGAKFpQ_I3d_dstzSCjkkUwinp9-4032SfYaorJ9-Wc8_XqX-i8C9N_XEin9xj7QNfuKSXaeleyfT6SjVdYMAQXphEX52_TCyZq4AyE7HFI7qReYm61YbblOWmuWtGUrZIqn3VrVCUJleCmrm3Z4KCqsmmqsaqMrKs6d_rRcSYk50yIsmCKs0E1KAdlDVmWSUbWpbgVaaZEb9xHf8eTtmKIS-71nNK6Z-W_THSZ6K7rKr7fGJ5nJrqnTya6D_Z7YcEbZjwJUoQVb1CshcV572KAMW6wB1zhCJY2iIHAuAkM4ZHceHgwznvYDk-PL9-0Xa8H3WuVSTYt6PwnV_rrnqcWPwEAAP__uCiLrQ) to error rates, and Texas could owe up to $2 billion in 2028-29 if its nearly 9% rate doesn't drop below 6%. Just 64% of applications were processed within 30 days, down from 91% last year and below the [federal 95% benchmark](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuupDAQAE9jMpBpvJgJHGxC9jbdEPXYDbTkD8I98Ob2q9krvLikUqn-fi1fyJHz9gcTOfley5LprpFE6Fx40HV_SSh3Tpgz523FxPH9XEDD2Pa6BbOgF75oMdgE99Th0TfkevuAaXhYY5vdBU0rwaCHYKxBo0dv6Jcfx9GCnsyEDbuPrtdg-l4DDJ22vfZ2QuNteFLQymgKLOXsZCehb6xrfJeLzs6X1ES3ixxVDb8VzArm-767NdfuVQN2W7kUzDXjoWDGkDgrmDkdZ7k4b20VFGqFE0XOVGt7olBtqXqMKFxye5zFf8D24oDZU3O6cNwcI9fRKqO3hBz_d8hP_10O_gUAAP__K7CH5A). HHSC said new mandates "require a thorough review of each case."
## Air Taxi Networks Planned for Texas
Archer Aviation unveiled plans on Friday for air taxi networks in Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth, and Houston, including all-electric flights from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport to [Circuit of the Americas](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO2zAQg59G3hTIZ9WKBw1dvP1dOxpn6ZwcKkuBfImSty_coS_wbwRIEOT3-2v5Qk6cb79wJy_vrSyZ2pFIhOrCgznuT4ml5R1z5nzbcOf0WRcwMOreaLALBuEXLRa76FcTp74j37sJrsPkrOvufhssXn-s5GAaRrcRjNcw9cM2jjaaEWLH_qzrDdi-NwDDxbjeBHdFG1xcKRplDUWWUi9yJ6E3Hlv6lBfVSyh7l_xd5HGo4aeCWcHcWrv8eWM-TQXz-UfBnErApGDG5yGc_wuNXLXgm_VB9cWB9CNhzhR1pqYpUZDK4UyFipvoWp5CupVnijqUnCmIxpVRhyKoYO6qj4_GKfExOmXNbUdO_2bKd_G-PPwNAAD___iDkl8). The [Dallas-Fort Worth network](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOwyAQRL_G7ogAYxMKimvS5dorrTVs4tVhiPDGTv7-5PzCdTMa6Y1mfq7jFShRvn_Dgp5ftzJm3NeEzFhH6uQ6PzmWPS-QM-X7DRZK72nUUg9CSaHNCIFpw9FAG_0ko1MtemWdPnfOGtvO3kbsjXVmstK5aMzQ6z7YodcIKjiAlvyBU1IbpaTW3UlaJYM9gwk2ThhlYyRG4lJPPCPjC9ZbepcN6ymUpU1-Zn6sTffV6EujL7DtOB3JRxMwlSyOVYevYcYqnnlDSqv4sARQFQwvEhl5L_VXPBLkRl_a6uNjp5RoHWxj5H0BSp9K_u9Vm9d_AQAA__8G-H9i) would link six airports with Frisco Station, while Houston's would connect Bush Intercontinental, Hobby, and Sugar Land to downtown and Galveston. Archer's [Midnight aircraft carries](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0bHO4yAQBOCnwR0RYGzyFy6ucfdfe6W1ho1ZBUME6zj5n_6Ue4XrZz5pNH--l2-gRHn7DTtO_LqVJePZEjJjXahXLR4cypl3yJnydoOd0ntdjDKj1Eoau4BneuJioQvTqsKX7nDS7stc-y9nXRenPoAdlV7N6DwOerAuXBX68eatH67WdTR9OK2M1VoZ01-U08q7K1jvwopBCaswEJd64YiML2i39C5PrBdf9i5NkfnRRP9LmFmY-TzPy4r5h_IGn4Aw8w71jtyEmRl9FGY2ozCzVsLMoxmGwfaDMDNUH7FKeBIwlSwh53Jkj03GcjQuWQZICZqEozFlyfAimZHPUu9NMgbp6_EjG7ybPCkl2bhi3jhilrBjJQ9ZJoSAtUV6yA8RUbY7YevqFB6fErXRCau2HSj9m8f_e8tzMn8DAAD__-LUpcY) four passengers and a pilot, and the company says it can turn 60- to 90-minute drives into 10- to 20-minute flights. There's no Texas launch date yet, but Archer plans flights in Los Angeles before beginning Texas operations. Texans can see the aircraft up close at the U.S. Grand Prix at COTA through Sunday.
| Flying together with our sponsor [](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LvO4yAQxfGnwV2iYUAQCoqVonTZdkuLyzhGwmCZ2VzefpV9ha8-R7_i_-c-30OppT1-h408v5c-N3qNSsx0zEXBWP9y7q-2hdZKeyxhK_UTZwQ0Jwkn1HNIXJ406zBlHyE7OZGX1uFFOavttHoDEJWJLiSLyjplk0WnYrTJaJ2XMBX_5SSglhIQ1RmshGQvQSebI2UQGigX7seZV2J6h7HUT3_ScU59m6pfmfch1C-BN4G3_ehMiSn3nUtv43v6LuoWhLpKbUGgSUJdERwYgWZIoa7T4fP-KrWWYazQ8NhCqf99_mmXp8d_AQAA__8OZnQz) **You Checked Your Car Insurance. What About Your Home?** Your homeowners insurance renews. You pay the bill. Another year goes by. But when was the last time you checked what other insurers would charge? If you've used Insurify for auto insurance, you already know the idea: compare your options and see whether there's a better fit for your budget. The closure covers both directions between I-35E and the I-45/U.S. 75 interchange, with traffic detoured onto Woodall Rodgers Freeway (Spur 366). TxDOT is urging drivers to avoid the area if they can. The shutdown is part of the $888 million I-30 Canyon Project, which broke ground in March and runs through 2031. The Texas A&M Transportation Institute ranks the Canyon as the state's 11th most congested corridor. Some crossings will stay closed long after this weekend: through late 2027 and Cesar Chavez Boulevard through late 2028. Austin drivers also will be hit with detours this weekend as for today's Viva La Vida Day of the Dead festival and the Formula 1 U.S. Grand Prix, which wraps up Sunday at Circuit of the Americas. Texas SNAP Enrollment Hits 17-Year Low Texas SNAP enrollment hit a of 2.8 million in September after falling 20.8% in a year, the steepest drop in two decades, with children making up more than half the losses. The drop follows last year's federal budget law, which extended work requirements to more parents and adults up to 64. It also to error rates, and Texas could owe up to $2 billion in 2028-29 if its nearly 9% rate doesn't drop below 6%. Just 64% of applications were processed within 30 days, down from 91% last year and below the . HHSC said new mandates "require a thorough review of each case." Air Taxi Networks Planned for Texas Archer Aviation unveiled plans on Friday for air taxi networks in Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth, and Houston, including all-electric flights from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport to . The would link six airports with Frisco Station, while Houston's would connect Bush Intercontinental, Hobby, and Sugar Land to downtown and Galveston. Archer's four passengers and a pilot, and the company says it can turn 60- to 90-minute drives into 10- to 20-minute flights. There's no Texas launch date yet, but Archer plans flights in Los Angeles before beginning Texas operations. Texans can see the aircraft up close at the U.S. Grand Prix at COTA through Sunday. | Flying together with our sponsor You Checked Your Car Insurance. What About Your Home? If you've used Insurify for auto insurance, you already know the idea: compare your options and see whether there's a better fit for your budget. Andy Barr is spending his corporate donors' money flooding the airwaves with attack ads against me, and it is mission-critical that we're able to keep our own ads on air and retaliate. | | ---|---|--- Pro-Andy Barr group Keep America Great PAC 's latest attack ad about me. I know it might feel like too little too late, but in times like these, there is no such thing. We have until October 29th for in-person early voting to officially kicks off, and I'm on the campaign trail as we speak, seeking out every undecided voter. Our message is a winning one. Our polls show it. All that's left to do is make sure everyone hears it before my opponent gets to them. Will you chip in $25 to help our team fight back in the last stretch to the finish line? I couldn't do it without you. Charles | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Charles Booker P.O. Box 1, Louisville, KY 40201 ? ?

I prayed we would never reach this point.
I want to start with an apology.
Not for asking for your support -- but for the possibility that we may not have done enough to earn it.

A note from Senator Ashley Moody |
---
Peter,
I'm going to be honest with you, because I don't know any other way to say this.
My heart breaks for France right now. City halls burning to the ground. More than 600 police officers injured in a single day. Rioters tearing the French flag off the monument to their own Republic – and raising a Palestinian flag in its place, while others march under the hammer and sickle.
Communists and radical Islamists, side by side in the streets. **That 's not a coincidence. That's an alliance.** And it has eyes on more than Europe.
This radical movement is working to infiltrate our own country – and it's counting on patriots like you not realizing it until it's too late.
It is the honor of my life to serve as Florida's U.S. Senator. My state is full of people who already know how this story ends. Families who fled Castro with nothing but the clothes on their backs. Venezuelans who watched their country get looted by socialists in a single generation. Nicaraguans who escaped Ortega. They came here because America was the one place it couldn't happen.
Here, that movement has a fellow traveler on the ballot, and her name is **Angie Nixon.**
She runs a bookstore called "Cafe Resistance." On its wall hang portraits of convicted cop killers – including Assata Shakur, who murdered a New Jersey state trooper and fled to Castro's Cuba. When she was confronted about it, she said she stands by "everything in this bookstore."
She closes her speeches with a line from the Communist Manifesto – "We have nothing to lose but our chains" – and she took that chant to a CAIR gala. She was one of just 7 votes against teaching students the history of communism. She signed the pledge to abolish ICE. She voted against tougher penalties for people who assault police officers.
And she just raised $7 million to take Florida's U.S. Senate seat – more than we raised in the same three months. And Bernie Sanders just pointed his $23 million war chest at this race and came to Florida himself to campaign for her and turn out the vote.
This is a special election – the biggest Senate race in the country this year – and some new polls say it's within the margin of error. If she wins, she becomes **the first dues-paying member of the Democratic Socialists of America in the U.S. Senate.**

My husband is a police officer. I spent my career as a prosecutor, a judge and an attorney general. I've stood with the families of officers who were attacked. I've stood in rooms full of people who escaped communism and wept when justice finally came. I made them a promise: _not here. Not in America._
**I can 't keep that promise alone.**

## _Dispatch from Paris:_
As soon as we touched down in Paris yesterday we hit the streets to see how locals are preparing for the October 24th scheduled demonstrations.
The air was filled with tension, and cigarette smoke as Parisians prepared for the worse.
## [Watch here:](https://substack.com/redirect/865a4736-80a4-435e-bf75-e6c05e02ed3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/865a4736-80a4-435e-bf75-e6c05e02ed3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/865a4736-80a4-435e-bf75-e6c05e02ed3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Macron issued citywide curfews and even deployed military units for crowd control after last weekend's protest devolved into violent and destructive riots.
Shop owners near Place de la Republique, the site of last week's riots, were boarding up their businesses frantically. Smashed windows and torn-down entry ways marked the entire strip.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0a18be07-4b1b-4220-96a2-f5580201268b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I asked as many people as I could if they thought Saturday's protest were going to be as violent or worse than the prior week's. The consensus: _" Oui."_
"I'm afraid the government is not ready," one man told me.
Several said that the blame lays with Macron's government refusing to act on student grievances related to crowded class sizes, underfunded schools, and teacher pensions.
I asked how destruction of property and historic monuments will achieve their goals. Many expressed disagreement with the violence, but agreed that it is an effective way to force the government's hand to take action.
"Why are we seeing communist and Palestinian flags at these protests?" I asked. "What does that have to do with student demands?"
"We want to stop support of Israel and that genocide," one man who apparently partakes in the protests told me, a response I heard from several people I spoke to yesterday.
"I think it's a lot of causes that unites them to make a bigger voice," he explained.
French conservative presidential candidate Marine Le Pen's chances of winning the April election surged recently correlating with the riots and Macron's weak response to unrest.
Le Pen now has **[a 50% chance of victory on Kalshi's odds](https://substack.com/redirect/81c94e8c-6eac-46c9-b78e-95da06ce70a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as more french people identify with her stricter immigration agenda and conservative fiscal policy proposals.

* * *
_**(Piece continues):**_
I also asked them to respond to President Trump's hypothesis, that open borders and France's lax immigration policy are largely to blame for the unrest and the obvious presence of migrant and 2nd/3rd gen immigrant rioters.
"They (the french government) wanted violence! That's what they were waiting for! So they can say 'see, I was right, those people are animals, those people are not supposed to be here!" one girl told me.
"Has mass migration been good for France?" I asked.
"Of course! It is a racist country. They have so much fear, they don't know where to put their fear. Society will grow (by mixing)," she explained.
That was the answer I heard most frequently from these parisians, that open borders has nothing to do with the riots and migration from the third world has been a great success for their country.
I am not convinced by this answer personally, based on the video reporting I've seen from previous riots of what appear to be islamist activist partaking in violence and destruction. But today, I will have the opportunity to see for myself who is involved as a mass gathering is planned for 2 pm Paris time at the former site of the Bastille where a monument to the french revolution stands today.
The government is taking this protest much more seriously than prior weeks, deploying riot police **[and even military units](https://substack.com/redirect/acbaf9a0-a134-45bd-82f6-209241648700?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to keep the crowd under control.
"The deployment next Saturday will be massive," Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said, explaining that the immediate priority was to restore order after what happened on October 17.
Our team will be publishing footage**[live to X](https://substack.com/redirect/b9b085d3-7d75-4551-a763-c2b7e54a4836?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and other social platforms including on YouTube on **[our PolitiBrawl Streetcast channel](https://substack.com/redirect/dd8c795a-09b2-428b-b661-33a9a46c2f38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** throughout the evening.

We asked Parisians who is REALLY behind the riots... | | | Oct 24 | | | | | | | | | | | | Dispatch from Paris: As soon as we touched down in Paris yesterday we hit the streets to see how locals are preparing for the October 24th scheduled demonstrations. The air was filled with tension, and cigarette smoke as Parisians prepared for the worse. President Macron issued citywide curfews and even deployed military units for crowd control after last weekend's protest devolved into violent and destructive riots. Shop owners near Place de la Republique, the site of last week's riots, were boarding up their businesses frantically. Smashed windows and torn-down entry ways marked the entire strip. I asked as many people as I could if they thought Saturday's protest were going to be as violent or worse than the prior week's. The consensus: " Oui." "I'm afraid the government is not ready," one man told me. Several said that the blame lays with Macron's government refusing to act on student grievances related to crowded class sizes, underfunded schools, and teacher pensions. I asked how destruction of property and historic monuments will achieve their goals. Many expressed disagreement with the violence, but agreed that it is an effective way to force the government's hand to take action. "Why are we seeing communist and Palestinian flags at these protests?" I asked. "What does that have to do with student demands?" "We want to stop support of Israel and that genocide," one man who apparently partakes in the protests told me, a response I heard from several people I spoke to yesterday. "I think it's a lot of causes that unites them to make a bigger voice," he explained. French conservative presidential candidate Marine Le Pen's chances of winning the April election surged recently correlating with the riots and Macron's weak response to unrest. Le Pen now has as more french people identify with her stricter immigration agenda and conservative fiscal policy proposals. | | ---|---|--- Get $25 in credit to trade on Kalshi after you sign up using our code "brawl" or by Kalshi supports independent media like PolitiBrawl! (Piece continues): I also asked them to respond to President Trump's hypothesis, that open borders and France's lax immigration policy are largely to blame for the unrest and the obvious presence of migrant and 2nd/3rd gen immigrant rioters. "They (the french government) wanted violence! That's what they were waiting for! So they can say 'see, I was right, those people are animals, those people are not supposed to be here!" one girl told me. "Has mass migration been good for France?" I asked. "Of course! It is a racist country. They have so much fear, they don't know where to put their fear. Society will grow (by mixing)," she explained. That was the answer I heard most frequently from these parisians, that open borders has nothing to do with the riots and migration from the third world has been a great success for their country. I am not convinced by this answer personally, based on the video reporting I've seen from previous riots of what appear to be islamist activist partaking in violence and destruction. But today, I will have the opportunity to see for myself who is involved as a mass gathering is planned for 2 pm Paris time at the former site of the Bastille where a monument to the french revolution stands today. The government is taking this protest much more seriously than prior weeks, deploying riot police to keep the crowd under control. "The deployment next Saturday will be massive," Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said, explaining that the immediate priority was to restore order after what happened on October 17. Our team will be publishing footage and other social platforms including on YouTube on throughout the evening. I’m reaching out today to send you your 2027 Hillsdale College calendar. I know, I know. It’s a little early to be thinking about 2027. But since you care about liberty and education, I wanted to make sure you had a chance to get the 2027 calendar. Claim your 2027 Hillsdale College calendar before October 31 by clicking on this secure link: Just in the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to... Teach 5 million Americans in Hillsdale’s free online courses , including “Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution,” and “Marxism, Socialism, and Communism”—which exposes the misery and brutality of communist regimes and the rise of Cultural Marxism in America. Distribute hundreds of thousands of free copies of the Constitution to citizens nationwide—especially younger Americans, and thousands of K-12 students. Provide an American classical education to young students nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms. Expand the circulation of Imprimis , Hillsdale’s monthly digest of liberty, to more than 7.5 million households and businesses. I hope you’ll claim your 2027 Hillsdale College calendar so that next year, you’ll remember how you’ve advanced the important work of defending liberty through education. Remember, your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny of government funding—even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. You’ll help enroll millions more Americans in free online courses, expand the readership of Imprimis , and restore excellence to K-12 education. Please show your support today by making your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $75, or $150—or the best gift you can—by clicking the secure link below: And when you do, I’ll send you your 2027 Hillsdale College calendar. But please act before October 31. Thank you for considering joining the ranks of our Hillsdale supporters. Your generosity is needed now more than ever. Warm regards,Bill Gray, ’01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College P.S.
